title: kate-lsp: read a hover result
summary: hover_params builds the textDocument/hover parameters. hover_text takes the result and returns the text to show: the value of a MarkupContent, a MarkedString string, the value of a language MarkedString, or an array of those joined by blank lines. Null is None.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Read result.contents. A string is the text. An object with value is that value. An array joins each element's text with a blank line. An empty text is None. The test hover_text_reads_each_shape asserts {"contents": {"kind": "markdown", "value": "doc"}} gives doc, {"contents": ["a", {"language": "rust", "value": "b"}]} gives a\n\nb, and null gives None. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: hover::tests::hover_text_reads_each_shape
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because hover_text does not exist. After the change the three content shapes give text and null gives None.
